name: por-vth
description: Full-assembly (real bias_core VREF, not idealised) release/assert threshold pair and hysteresis extraction of design/netlist/temp_por_top.spice: one DUT, one quasi-static 0->VDD->1.5 V triangle-wave ramp, measured on the internal POR_RAW node.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-rise, #por-vth-fall, #por-hysteresis -- corner-worst-case (deterministic, not Monte Carlo) full-assembly extraction, complementing sim/por-comparator-designer-check/'s idealised-VREF/IBIAS cell-level record with bias_core's real corner-dependent VREF in the loop. Deterministic corners only: design.ngspice sets sw_stat_mismatch=0, so the [3sigma] mismatch share stays #15's job and these rows remain conditional #15.
analyses: meas tran vpor_rise find v(vdd) when v(xdut.por_raw)=1.5 rise=1
meas tran vpor_rise_last find v(vdd) when v(xdut.por_raw)=1.5 rise=last
meas tran vpor_fall find v(vdd) when v(xdut.por_raw)=1.5 fall=1
meas tran vpor_fall_last find v(vdd) when v(xdut.por_raw)=1.5 fall=last
meas tran vref_settle_early find v(xdut.vref) at=8.5m
meas tran vref_settle_late find v(xdut.vref) at=13.9m
meas tran por_raw_top find v(xdut.por_raw) at=13.9m
meas tran vdd_top find v(vdd) at=13.9m

vpor_rise_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-rise (VPOR-uparrow, release threshold), full assembly, real bias_core VREF. Max binds at SS/-40C, min binds at FF/+125C per the ratified table.

vpor_fall_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-fall (VPOR-downarrow, assert threshold), same corner point as vpor_rise_v (same deck, same corner libs, same .temp, same rail).

v_hys_mv.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-hysteresis: V_hys = VPOR-uparrow - VPOR-downarrow, both edges measured at the same corner point, full assembly.

rise_chatter_mv.description: Anti-chatter guard on the release edge (first vs. last rising crossing on the up-ramp). A correct comparator crosses exactly once.

fall_chatter_mv.description: Same guard on the assert edge (first vs. last falling crossing on the down-ramp).

vref_settle_early_v.description: bias_core's real VREF 0.5 ms after the up-ramp reaches full rail, informative -- confirms the threshold measured above is riding on a settled reference, not a startup transient. Not a spec row of its own (see design/bias_core.md).

vref_settle_late_v.description: same, 0.1 ms before the down-ramp starts (still at full rail, settled).

vref_settle_drift_mv.description: harness/settling-integrity guard: VREF must not still be moving between the two samples 5.4 ms apart on a static rail. A reference that is still slewing here would invalidate 'quasi-static' for the down-ramp edge.

por_raw_hi_droop_mv.description: POR_RAW's released-high level against the rail at the same instant, informative/integrity: the comparator's decision node must be a solid rail-referenced high before the down-ramp begins, so the falling crossing below is a real re-assert and not a recovery from a weak high. Mirrors sim/por-comparator-designer-check/'s por_hi_droop_mv.
